item.title: President Lee Arrives in Argentina... Summit with President Milei on the 31st (李대통령, 아르헨 도착...31일 밀레이 대통령과 정상회담)
item.description:
President Lee Arrives in Argentina... Summit with President Milei on the 31st (李대통령, 아르헨 도착...31일 밀레이 대통령과 정상회담)

President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a tour of the United States and three South American countries, arrived in Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, the final stop of his visit, on the 30th (local time), beginning his official itinerary. This marks the first visit by a South Korean president to Argentina in 22 years. (미국과 남미 3국을 순방 중인 이재명 대통령이 30일(현지 시각) 마지막 방문국인 아르헨티나의 수도 부에노스아이레스에 도착해 공식 방문 일정을 시작했다. 한국 대통령의 아르헨티나 방문은 22년 만이다.)

On the morning of the 31st, President Lee will lay a wreath at San Martín Square, which honors Argentina's independence heroes, and hold a summit with Argentine President Javier Milei at the presidential palace. In the afternoon of the same day, he will meet with Buenos Aires Mayor Macri and hold a dinner meeting with local Korean residents. (이 대통령은 31일 오전 아르헨티나 독립 영웅을 기리는 산마르틴 광장에서 헌화하고, 대통령궁에서 하비에르 밀레이 아르헨티나 대통령과 정상회담을 갖는다. 같은 날 오후엔 마크리 부에노스아이레스 시장을 접견하고, 현지 동포들과 만찬 간담회를 갖는다.)

The presidential office said of President Lee's visit, "We expect to elevate cooperation with Argentina, which holds all key elements of economic security such as critical minerals, energy, and food, to a new level." (청와대는 이 대통령의 이번 방문에 대해 “핵심 광물과 에너지, 식량 등 경제 안보의 주요 요소를 모두 보유한 아르헨티나와의 협력을 새로운 단계로 발전시킬 것으로 기대한다”고 했다.)

In this regard, President Lee is expected to discuss ways to establish a stable cooperation framework for the supply chain of critical minerals during his talks with President Milei. Argentina is the world's fourth-largest holder of lithium reserves, which is essential for batteries and other products. (이와 관련, 이 대통령은 밀레이 대통령과 회담에서 안정적인 핵심 광물 공급망 협력 체계 구축 방안을 논의할 예정이다. 아르헨티나는 배터리 등에 필수인 리튬 세계 4위 매장국이다.)

Discussions are also expected on resuming negotiations for a South Korea-MERCOSUR (Southern Common Market) trade agreement. Argentina, along with Brazil, is a key member of MERCOSUR. President Lee had previously discussed resuming the South Korea-MERCOSUR trade agreement negotiations with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The negotiations for the South Korea-MERCOSUR trade agreement were officially launched in 2018 but have been suspended since the seventh round of talks in 2021. (한·메르코수르(MERCOSUR·남미 공동 시장) 무역 협정 협상 재개 논의도 할 것으로 보인다. 아르헨티나는 브라질과 함께 메르코수르의 핵심 회원국이다. 이 대통령은 앞서 루이스 이나시우 룰라 다 시우바 브라질 대통령과도 한·메르코수르 무역 협정 협상 재개를 논의했다. 한·메르코수르 무역 협정 협상은 2018년 협상 개시를 공식 선언했지만, 2021년 7차 회의 이후 중단된 상태다.)

After visiting San Francisco in the United States and then traveling to Brazil, Chile, and Argentina in South America, President Lee will return home via Frankfurt, Germany, on the 2nd of next month. (미국 샌프란시스코를 방문한 뒤 남미의 브라질, 칠레, 아르헨티나를 찾은 이 대통령은 다음 달 2일 독일 프랑크푸르트를 거쳐 귀국한다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Recommends Attorney Choi Gil-su as Special Inspector Candidate (민주당 특별감찰관 후보로 최길수 변호사 추천)
item.description:
Democratic Party Recommends Attorney Choi Gil-su as Special Inspector Candidate (민주당 특별감찰관 후보로 최길수 변호사 추천)

<<>> The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 31st that it is recommending Attorney Choi Gil-su as a candidate for the presidential office's special inspector. ()

At a press conference held that day, Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do stated, "Attorney Choi has served as the head of the special investigations division at the Gwangju District Prosecutors' Office, chief of the Andong branch of the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office, and worked in the inspection division at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office, making him an expert in the field of inspection," and proposed completing the special inspector recommendation process by August. The People Power Party had already recommended Attorney Kang Ji-sik as its candidate. (더불어민주당은 31일 청와대 특별감찰관 후보로 최길수 변호사를 추천한다고 밝혔다.)

The special inspector is responsible for investigating misconduct by the president's relatives and senior secretarial-level aides at the presidential office, and the position has remained vacant for ten years, following the Moon Jae-in and Yoon Suk Yeol administrations. (민주당 한병도 원내대표는 이날 기자회견에서 ”최 변호사는 광주지검 특수부장 검사, 대구지검 안동지청장을 역임했고, 서울고검 감찰부에서 근무한 감찰 분야 전문가”라며 8월 중 특별감찰관 추천 절차를 마무리하자고 제안했다. 국민의힘은 이미 강지식 변호사를 후보로 추천했었다.)

Attorney Choi Gil-su passed the 33rd bar examination in October 1991 and was appointed as a prosecutor at the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office in March 1997. He subsequently served as deputy chief prosecutor of Special Division 3 at the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, head of the special investigations division at the Gwangju District Prosecutors' Office, professor at the Legal Training Institute, chief of the Andong branch of the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office, and prosecutor in the inspection division at the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office, until August 2017. (특별감찰관은 대통령의 친인척과 청와대 수석비서관급 이상 참모의 비리를 감찰하는데, 문재인·윤석열 정부에 이어 10년째 공석인 상태다.)

The Democratic Party cited the case from 2019 when the Bareunmirae Party recommended Attorney Choi Gil-su as a special inspector candidate, saying, "We do not anticipate any controversy over neutrality." (최길수 변호사는 1991년 10월 제33회 사법시험에 합격해 1997년 3월 대구지방검찰청 검사로 임용된 이래 2017년 8월까지 서울중앙지방검찰청 특수3부 부부장검사, 광주지방검찰청 특수부장검사, 법무연수원 교수, 대구지방검찰청 안동지청장, 서울고등검찰청 감찰부 검사를 거쳤다.)

The process for appointing a special inspector is as follows: the Democratic Party and the People Power Party each recommend three candidates who have worked as judges, prosecutors, or lawyers for at least 15 years, and the president selects one of them. The nominated candidate must then also undergo a confirmation hearing at the National Assembly. (민주당은 지난 2019년 바른미래당이 특별감찰관 후보로 최길수 변호사를 추천했던 사례를 예로 들면서 “중립성 논란은 없을 것으로 본다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to push through a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that would fully abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation power at a plenary session of the National Assembly on the afternoon of that day. The People Power Party launched a filibuster (unlimited debate) that afternoon to block the bill's passage, but the Democratic Party plans to end the debate through a vote 24 hours later, on the 31st, in accordance with the National Assembly Act, and process the bill. (특별감찰관은 더불어민주당과 국민의힘 등이 15년 이상 판·검사 혹은 변호사로 활동한 후보자 3인을 추천하면, 그 중 1명을 대통령이 지명하는 절차다. 지명된 후보자는 그 후 국회에서 인사청문회도 거쳐야 한다.)

For this reason, some in the opposition have suggested, "Isn't this a tactical announcement to avoid criticism over the ruling party's unilateral legislative processing?" In response, the Democratic Party said, "We have been working on the special inspector recommendation since earlier," and added, "It is unrelated to the legislative procedures at the plenary session." (민주당은 이날 오후 검찰의 보완수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법 개정안을 국회 본회의에서 강행 처리 예정이다. 국민의힘은 법안 통과를 막기 위해 이날 오후 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 돌입했지만, 민주당은 국회법에 따라 24시간 후인 31일 표결로 토론을 중단시키고 법안을 처리하겠다는 계획이다.)

item.title: Presidential Office: "Special Inspector Nominee, Will Proceed with Appointment Promptly Once Recommended by National Assembly" (靑 “특별감찰관, 국회서 추천하면 신속히 임명 진행”)
item.description:
Presidential Office: "Special Inspector Nominee, Will Proceed with Appointment Promptly Once Recommended by National Assembly" (靑 “특별감찰관, 국회서 추천하면 신속히 임명 진행”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea recommended former prosecutor attorney Choi Gil-su as a candidate for special inspector on the 31st, the presidential office stated that it would proceed with the appointment promptly once the National Assembly's recommendation process is concluded. (더불어민주당이 31일 특별감찰관 후보자로 검사 출신 최길수 변호사를 추천한 가운데 청와대가 국회의 추천 절차가 마무리되면 신속하게 임명을 진행하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Seong Ki-hong, senior presidential secretary for public relations, said in a media notice that day, "President Lee Jae-myung has emphasized the need to appoint a special inspector since his inaugural press conference in July of last year," adding, "He has since requested and proposed this on multiple occasions." He further stated, "If the National Assembly recommends a special inspector candidate through a plenary session vote, the presidential office will proceed with the appointment promptly in accordance with procedures." (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “이재명 대통령은 지난해 7월 취임 기자회견부터 특별감찰관 임명의 필요성을 강조한 바 있다”며 “이후에도 수차례 이를 요청하고 제안해 왔다”고 했다. 이어 “국회가 본회의 의결을 거쳐 특별감찰관 후보를 추천하면 청와대는 절차에 따라 신속히 임명을 진행할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

The special inspector oversees corruption among the president's spouse, relatives within the fourth degree of kinship, and senior presidential staff at or above the level of senior secretary. The position had remained vacant for nearly a decade since Lee Seok-su, the first special inspector, in 2016. (특별감찰관은 대통령 배우자와 4촌 이내의 친족, 청와대 수석비서관급 이상 참모의 비리를 감찰한다. 2016년 이석수 초대 특별감찰관 이후 10년 가까이 공석이었다.)

According to the Special Inspector Act, the National Assembly must recommend three special inspector candidates in writing to the president, selected from lawyers who have held positions as judges, prosecutors, or attorneys under Article 42, Paragraph 1, Item 1 of the Court Organization Act for at least 15 years. The president must designate one of the recommended candidates as special inspector within three days of receiving the recommendation, and the candidate is appointed after undergoing a confirmation hearing at the National Assembly. Earlier, the People Power Party recommended attorney Kang Ji-sik as a special inspector candidate in April. (특별감찰관법에 따르면 국회는 15년 이상 법원조직법 제42조제1항제1호의 직(판사, 검사, 변호사)의 직에 있던 변호사 중에서 3명의 특별감찰관 후보자를 대통령에게 서면으로 추천해야 한다. 대통령은 추천서를 받은 날부터 3일 내 추천 후보자 중 한 명을 특별감찰관으로 지명하고, 후보자는 국회 인사 청문회를 거쳐 임명된다. 앞서 국민의힘은 지난 4월 강지식 변호사를 특별감찰관 후보자로 추천한 바 있다.)

item.title: Blue House on National Assembly's Passage of Criminal Procedure Act to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Powers: "Respect the National Assembly's Judgment" (靑, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 형소법 국회 통과에 “국회 판단 존중”)
item.description:
Blue House on National Assembly's Passage of Criminal Procedure Act to Abolish Supplementary Investigation Powers: "Respect the National Assembly's Judgment" (靑, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 형소법 국회 통과에 “국회 판단 존중”)

The Blue House said on the 31st that it "respects the legislative process and final judgment of the National Assembly" regarding the passage of the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act, which fully abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative authority. (청와대는 31일 검사의 직접 수사 권한을 전면 폐지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안이 국회 본회의를 통과한 것에 대해 “국회의 입법 과정과 최종 판단을 존중한다”고 밝혔다.)

Seong Ki-hong, the Blue House senior secretary for public relations and communication, made this statement through a press notice, adding, "This revision of the Criminal Procedure Act will prevent the monopoly and abuse of power by separating investigation from prosecution, while enhancing the level of protection for victims and the human rights of the people, bringing the criminal justice system one step closer to the public." (성기홍 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 언론 공지를 통해 이같이 밝히며 “이번 형사소송법 개정은 수사와 기소의 분리를 통해 권력의 독점과 남용을 막는 한편, 피해자와 국민 인권 보호 수준을 높임으로써 형사사법 시스템이 국민 곁으로 한 걸음 더 다가서도록 할 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "The Blue House will do its utmost to ensure that this amendment is implemented without disruption in the field and that the people can feel the change in their daily lives." (이어 “청와대는 이번 개정안이 현장에서 차질 없이 시행되고, 국민께서 삶 속에서 그 변화를 체감하실 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

The amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act passed on this day with 175 votes in favor out of 178 lawmakers present, as the People Power Party boycotted the vote. Under the Constitution, once a bill passes the National Assembly, it must be transferred to the government, and the president must promulgate it within 15 days or request reconsideration by the National Assembly. (이날 형사소송법 개정안은 국민의힘이 표결에 불참한 가운데 재석 178명 중 찬성 175명으로 가결됐다. 헌법상 국회를 통과한 법률안은 정부로 이송된 뒤 15일 이내에 대통령이 공포하거나 국회에 재의를 요구해야 한다.)

The People Power Party demanded that President Lee Jae-myung exercise his right to request reconsideration (veto), calling the bill "a heinous law that will remain a disgrace in constitutional history." However, given that the Blue House has expressed its intention to respect the National Assembly's decision, President Lee is expected not to exercise his veto. (국민의힘은 이재명 대통령을 향해 “헌정사(史)에 수치로 남을 희대의 악법”이라며 재의요구권(거부권)을 행사하라고 요구했다. 그러나 청와대가 국회 뜻을 존중하겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 만큼, 이 대통령은 거부권을 행사하지 않을 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: After Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights... Kim Min-seok "Achievement of Lee" Jung Cheong-rae "Report to Roh" (보완수사권 폐지되자... 김민석 “李 성과” 정청래 “盧에 보고”)
item.description:
After Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights... Kim Min-seok "Achievement of Lee" Jung Cheong-rae "Report to Roh" (보완수사권 폐지되자... 김민석 “李 성과” 정청래 “盧에 보고” )

Ahead of the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea national convention, the Criminal Procedure Act, which completely abolishes prosecutors' investigative powers, passed the National Assembly plenary session on the 31st, and party leadership candidates issued messages welcoming the move in unison. (8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 31일 국회 본회의에서 검사의 수사권을 완전 폐지하는 형사소송법이 통과되자 당권 주자들이 일제히 환영한다는 메시지를 냈다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok emphasized that this was an achievement of President Lee Jae-myung. On Facebook that day, he wrote, "We have crossed another great mountain of prosecutorial reform," adding, "It was not easy. Thank you." He continued, "This is another historic achievement created by the strong will and reformist resolve of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which proved its promises to the people through action." (김민석 후보는 이재명 대통령의 성과임을 강조했다. 그는 이날 페이스북에 “검찰개혁의 큰 산을 또 하나 넘었다”며 “쉽지 않았다. 감사합니다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “국민과의 약속을 실천으로 증명해 낸 이재명 정부의 강력한 의지와 개혁적 결단이 만들어낸 또 하나의 역사적 성과”라고 했다.)

He also said, "We will steadfastly and meticulously continue the path of prosecutorial and judicial reform that protects the people and the vulnerable." (또 “국민과 약자를 지키는 검찰개혁, 사법개혁의 길을 촘촘하게, 흔들림 없이 가겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Jung wrote on Facebook, "I report to President Roh Moo-hyun that the prosecutorial reform bill has passed," adding, "Today, thinking of the President, I don't think I'd be the least bit ashamed to cry my heart out." (정 후보는 페이스북에 “노무현 대통령님 검찰개혁 법안 통과를 보고드립니다”라며 “오늘은 대통령님을 생각하면서 실컷 울어도 하나도 창피하지 않을 것 같다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Strong reform invites strong resistance, and the final resistance is the strongest," adding, "Against the People Power Party, which shows no remorse for the insurrection, and the outrageous claims of the prosecution and media colluding with them, we never yielded even in moments of crisis when they tried to delay and obstruct reform." (이어 “강력한 개혁에는 강력한 저항이 따르는데 마지막 저항이 가장 강하다”며 “내란에 대해 반성하지 않는 국민의힘, 이와 유착한 검찰·언론의 무도한 주장에 맞서 개혁을 지연시키고 방해하려는 위기의 순간에도 결코 굴하지 않았다”고 했다.)

Candidate Jung said, "I kept my promise to the people, whom I assured that on the radio news during the Chuseok holiday travel, they would hear the joyful news that the prosecution service has faded into history," adding, "Throughout all the years I have been part of the Democratic Party, I have never once forgotten prosecutorial reform." (정 후보는 “추석 귀향길 라디오 뉴스에 검찰청이 역사 속으로 사라지게 되었다는 기쁜 소식을 전해드리겠다고 했던 국민과의 약속을 지켰다”며 “민주당에 몸담은 지난 세월 동안 검찰개혁을 한시도 잊은 적이 없다”고 했다.)

Candidate Song Young-gil, targeting Candidate Jung, said, "Passage with one person, one vote, and abolition of supplementary investigation rights," adding, "It will no longer be used as a political slogan in the party convention." He then took aim, saying, "I will examine at the next debate what justification Candidate Jung Cheong-rae has for running for party leader." (송영길 후보는 정 후보를 겨냥해 “1인 1표 통과, 보완수사권 폐지”라며 “더 이상 전당대회 정치 슬로건으로 활용될 일이 없어졌다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정청래 후보의 당대표 출마 명분이 무엇인지 다음 토론회에서 검증해 보겠다”고 겨냥했다.)

Regarding concerns over a vacuum in investigations, he said, "I am well aware that some citizens are worried about the abolition of supplementary investigation rights. They worry whether there will be gaps in investigations or whether their cases will be buried. I take those voices seriously." (또 수사 공백에 대해선 “보완수사권 폐지에 대해 걱정하시는 국민들이 계시다는 것을 잘 알고 있다”며 “수사에 공백이 생기지는 않을지, 내 사건이 묻히지는 않을지 하는 걱정이다. 그 목소리를 무겁게 받아들인다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Prosecutors' Direct Investigation Powers Stripped After 72 Years... Passed by National Assembly Plenary Session Led by Ruling Party ([속보] 검사 직접 수사권 72년 만에 박탈... 與 주도로 국회 본회의 통과)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Prosecutors' Direct Investigation Powers Stripped After 72 Years... Passed by National Assembly Plenary Session Led by Ruling Party ([속보] 검사 직접 수사권 72년 만에 박탈... 與 주도로 국회 본회의 통과)

<<>> A revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes prosecutors' direct investigation authority passed the National Assembly plenary session on the 31st, led by the Democratic Party of Korea. ()

The National Assembly passed the Criminal Procedure Act revision with 175 votes in favor out of 178 present. There were 2 votes against and 1 abstention. Democratic Party lawmaker Kwak Sang-eon and Reform Party lawmaker Lee Ju-young cast dissenting votes, while Democratic Party lawmaker Lee So-young abstained. The People Power Party, which had launched a filibuster (unlimited debate) from the afternoon of the previous day in opposition to the bill's handling, did not participate in the vote. (검사의 직접 수사 권한을 전면 폐지하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안이 31일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의를 통과했다.)

The approved revision to the Criminal Procedure Act completely separates investigation from prosecution, eliminating prosecutors' direct investigation. Prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers and direct warrant request authority have also been abolished. (국회는 이날 형사소송법 개정안을 재석 178명 중 찬성 175명으로 가결했다. 반대는 2명, 기권은 1명이었다. 더불어민주당 곽상언 의원과 개혁신당 이주영 의원이 반대표를 던졌고, 민주당 이소영 의원은 기권했다. 이 법안 처리에 반대하며 전날 오후부터 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 돌입했던 국민의힘은 표결에 불참했다.)

Additionally, the Democratic Party added grounds for courts to "dismiss indictments" in this Criminal Procedure Act. Dismissal of indictment is a procedure that terminates a case without ruling on guilt or innocence when there are serious defects in the prosecution itself. Although the current law lists six grounds for dismissal of indictment, the Democratic Party added "serious illegal investigation" and "deviation from prosecutorial discretion." In response, voices within the opposition camp said, "This is aimed at President Lee Jae-myung's trial." (이번에 통과된 형소법 개정안은 수사와 기소를 완전히 분리해 검사의 직접 수사를 없애는 내용이다. 검사의 보완수사권과 직접 영장 청구권도 폐지됐다.)

Following the bill's passage, the People Power Party demanded that President Lee Jae-myung exercise his request for reconsideration (veto power). People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik said, "Now the ball is in President Lee Jae-myung's court" and "If he doesn't want this bill to be branded as the Lee Jae-myung escape law, he should exercise his veto power." He added, "The People Power Party will exhaust all means and methods, including filing a constitutional complaint, to abolish this bad law." (또 민주당은 이번 형사소송법에 법원의 ‘공소 기각’ 사유도 추가했다. 공소 기각은 공소 제기에 중대한 하자가 있을 때 유무죄를 판단하지 않고 사건을 종결하는 절차다. 현행법에 6가지 공소 기각 사유가 있는데도 민주당은 ‘중대한 위법 수사’ ‘소추(訴追) 재량권 일탈’ 등을 추가했다. 이를 두고 야권에선 “이재명 대통령의 재판을 염두에 둔 것”이라는 말이 나왔다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-min: "Dismissal of Indictment Theoretically Applicable to President Lee's Trial" (김용민 “공소 기각, 李대통령 재판에 이론적으로 적용 가능”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-min: "Dismissal of Indictment Theoretically Applicable to President Lee's Trial" (김용민 “공소 기각, 李대통령 재판에 이론적으로 적용 가능”)

The Democratic Party of Korea stated on the 31st that the newly added provision for dismissal of indictment in the Criminal Procedure Act, which passed the National Assembly plenary session, is "theoretically applicable" to President Lee Jae-myung's criminal trials. Criminal trials involving President Lee, including the Daejang-dong and Wirye development corruption cases and the alleged slush fund scandal related to Seongnam FC sponsorships, remain suspended during his term. The Democratic Party has consistently challenged the legitimacy of these trials, characterizing them as "fabricated indictments" and successively proposing parliamentary investigations and special counsel laws. Floor leader Han Byung-do said that day, "The revision of the Criminal Procedure Act is not the end of prosecution reform but the beginning of a new criminal justice system." (더불어민주당은 31일 국회 본회의를 통과한 형사소송법에 신설된 공소기각 조항을 두고 “(이재명 대통령의 형사재판에도) 이론적으로 적용 가능하다”는 입장을 밝혔다. 이 대통령이 연루된 대장동·위례 개발 비리와 성남FC 후원금 의혹 사건 등 형사재판은 임기 중 중지된 상태다. 민주당은 그동안 해당 사건을 ‘조작 기소’로 규정하며 국정조사와 특검법을 잇달아 발의하는 등 재판의 정당성에 문제를 제기해 왔다. 한병도 원내대표는 이날 “형사소송법 개정은 검찰 개혁의 끝이 아닌 새로운 형사 사법 체계의 시작”이라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Yong-min, who led the legislative revision, said on SBS Radio that day, in response to a question about whether the newly established grounds for dismissal of indictment could apply to President Lee's cases, "Theoretically, they could apply," adding, "However, even without this provision, if an investigation is unlawful under existing regulations, dismissal of indictment is already possible." As for why it was explicitly codified in law despite this, he said, "It codifies existing case law." The precedent cited by the Democratic Party and Kim is the 2021 "case of fabricated espionage evidence against Seoul city official Yoo Woo-sung." Kim served as Yoo's defense attorney at the time. (법 개정을 주도한 김용민 의원은 이날 SBS라디오에서 이 대통령 사건에 신설된 공소기각 사유가 적용될 수 있느냐는 질문에 “이론적으로는 적용될 수 있다”며 “다만 이 조항이 없어도 기존 규정만으로도 위법한 수사라면 공소기각은 가능하다”고 말했다. 그런데도 굳이 법에 명문화한 데 대해서는 “기존 판례를 조문화한 것”이라고 했다. 민주당과 김 의원이 든 판례는 2021년 ‘서울시 공무원 유우성씨 간첩 증거 조작 사건’이다. 김 의원은 당시 유씨 변호인을 맡았다.)

Regarding why the content already established in precedent was specifically written into the bill, Kim said, "New prosecutors may not be aware of precedents," and "The intent is to make them recognize, while reviewing Article 327 of the Criminal Procedure Act, that 'we need to pay more attention to this part.'" (판례로 적시된 내용을 굳이 법안에 명시한 이유가 무엇인지에 대해 김 의원은 “새로 검사가 되는 사람들은 판례를 모를 수도 있다”며 “형사소송법 327조를 보면서 ‘이 부분을 더 신경 써야겠다’고 인식시키자는 취지”라고 했다.)

In response to criticism that this amendment is tailored legislation for President Lee, Kim rebutted, "If that were the case, impeaching the prosecutors would have been far easier," and "There's no reason to do it this way." (김 의원은 이번 개정안이 이 대통령을 위한 맞춤형 입법이라는 지적에 대해 “그럴거면 검사 탄핵을 하는 것이 훨씬 쉬웠을 것”이라며 “굳이 이런 방식으로 할 이유가 없다”고 반박했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to hold a public briefing on the 3rd regarding the revised Criminal Procedure Act, explaining the purpose of the bill and the direction of future criminal justice system reforms. (민주당은 3일 개정된 형사소송법을 주제로 한 대국민 보고회를 열고 법안 취지와 향후 형사 사법 체계 개편 방향을 설명할 예정이다.)

item.title: 72-Year-Old 'Prosecutors' Investigative Authority' Finally Abolished (72년 된 ‘검찰 수사권’ 결국 없앴다)
item.description:
72-Year-Old 'Prosecutors' Investigative Authority' Finally Abolished (72년 된 ‘검찰 수사권’ 결국 없앴다)

The Democratic Party of Korea pushed through a revised Criminal Procedure Act on the 31st at a plenary session of the National Assembly, fully abolishing prosecutors' direct investigative authority. As a result, the prosecution's investigative power, which had been maintained for 72 years since the enactment of the Criminal Procedure Act in 1954, has become a thing of the past. The People Power Party called it "one of the worst laws that will go down in constitutional history as a disgrace" and demanded that the president exercise his veto power (request for reconsideration). Acting Prosecutor General Koo Ja-hyun expressed his resignation immediately after the bill passed, saying, "I feel a deep sense of responsibility." (더불어민주당이 31일 국회 본회의에서 검찰의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지하는 형사소송법(형소법) 개정안을 강행 처리했다. 이로써 1954년 형소법 제정 이후 72년 동안 유지돼 온 검찰의 수사권이 역사 속으로 사라지게 됐다. 국민의힘은 “헌정사(史)에 수치로 남을 희대의 악법”이라며 대통령에게 거부권(재의요구권) 행사를 요구했다. 구자현 검찰총장 직무대행은 법안 통과 직후 “책임을 통감한다”면서 사의를 표명했다.)

On that day, the Democratic Party forcibly ended the People Power Party's filibuster at the plenary session and passed the revised Criminal Procedure Act with 175 votes in favor, 2 against, and 1 abstention out of 178 present. Within the Democratic Party, lawmaker Kwak Sang-eon, who had argued for partially retaining supplementary investigative authority, voted against, while lawmaker Lee So-young abstained. People Power Party lawmakers opposed the bill and did not participate in the vote. (민주당은 이날 본회의에서 국민의힘의 필리버스터(무제한 토론)를 강제 종료한 뒤 재석 178명 중 찬성 175명, 반대 2명, 기권 1명으로 형소법 개정안을 통과시켰다. 민주당에서도 보완수사권 일부 존치를 주장해 온 곽상언 의원이 반대표를, 이소영 의원은 기권표를 던졌다. 국민의힘 의원들은 법안에 반대하며 표결에 불참했다.)

The core of the revised bill is to separate investigation from prosecution, aligning with the abolition of the Prosecution Service and the launch of the Public Prosecution Office and the Serious Crimes Investigation Office on October 2. It fully abolishes prosecutors' direct investigative authority and unifies judicial police officers as the sole investigative主体. Prosecutors' authority to request warrants based on direct investigation also disappears. However, instead of direct investigation, prosecutors are granted the authority to "request" supplementary investigation, reinvestigation, and corrective measures from the police, allowing them indirect involvement in criminal proceedings. The Democratic Party stated, "We have finally completed the prosecution reform ordered by the people" and "The revision of the Criminal Procedure Act is not the end of prosecution reform but the beginning of a new criminal justice system." The presidential office said, "We respect the legislative process and final decision of the National Assembly." Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho said on the same day, "If side effects emerge on this uncharted path, contrary to good intentions or expectations, I hope there will be no hesitation in promptly supplementing and amending." (개정안은 오는 10월2일 검찰청 폐지와 공소청·중대범죄수사청 출범에 맞춰 수사와 기소를 분리하는 내용이 골자다. 검사의 직접 수사권을 전면 폐지하고 사법경찰관을 수사 주체로 일원화한다. 검사의 직접 수사에 따른 영장청구권도 사라진다. 다만 검사는 직접 수사 대신 경찰에 보완수사·재수사·시정조치 ‘요구권’을 부여받아 형사 절차에 간접 관여하게 됐다. 민주당은 “국민이 명령한 검찰개혁을 마침내 완성했다”며 “형소법 개정은 검찰 개혁의 끝이 아닌 새로운 형사사법체계의 시작”이라고 했다. 청와대는 “국회의 입법 과정과 최종 판단을 존중한다”고 밝혔다. 정성호 법무부 장관은 이날 “처음 가는 길에서 선의나 기대와는 달리 부작용이 나온다면 신속히 보완·수정하는 데에도 주저하지 않기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Earlier, concerns were raised from all walks of life, including within the ruling party itself, that fully abolishing prosecutors' investigative authority "would create a serious gap in protecting victims' rights." Nevertheless, the Democratic Party pushed the bill through, even inserting a provision to expand the grounds for dismissal of prosecution. This allows courts to dismiss a prosecution if "serious illegal investigation" or "clear abuse of prosecutorial discretion" is recognized. (앞서 각계각층은 물론 여당 내부에서도 검사 수사권 전면 폐지에 대해 “피해자 권익 보호에 심각한 구멍이 생긴다”며 우려를 표했다. 하지만 민주당은 ‘공소기각 사유 확대’ 조항까지 끼워 넣어 법안 처리를 밀어붙였다. ‘중대한 위법 수사’나 ‘현저한 공소권 남용’이 인정되면 법원에서 공소를 기각할 수 있도록 한 것이다.)

Regarding this provision, the opposition has criticized it as "a law designed to erase the trials of President Lee Jae-myung." People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik said, "In a word, the Criminal Procedure Act strips away the shield for the socially vulnerable and raises a bulletproof vest for those in power." (이 조항을 두고 야당은 “이재명 대통령의 재판 지우기를 위한 법”이라고 비판해 왔다. 정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 “형소법은 한마디로 사회적 약자의 방어막은 빼앗고 권력자의 방탄막을 내세운 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: A year into the Lee administration... Ruling party recommends attorney Choi Gil-soo as special inspector (李정부 1년 만에… 與, 특별감찰관에 최길수 변호사 추천)
item.description:
A year into the Lee administration... Ruling party recommends attorney Choi Gil-soo as special inspector (李정부 1년 만에… 與, 특별감찰관에 최길수 변호사 추천)

The Democratic Party of Korea recommended Choi Gil-soo (60, Judicial Research and Training Institute Class 23), a former prosecutor turned attorney, as a candidate for special inspector on the 31st. This comes about a year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration. Han Byung-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, held an unscheduled press conference that day to announce the recommendation, saying, "Attorney Choi is the right person to carry out his duties independently from the perspective of the public." (더불어민주당은 31일 특별감찰관 후보로 검사 출신 최길수(60·사법연수원 23기) 변호사를 추천했다. 이재명 정부 출범 1년여 만이다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표는 이날 예정에 없던 기자간담회를 열어 특별감찰관 추천 사실을 밝히고 “최 변호사는 국민 눈높이에서 독립적으로 직무를 수행할 적임자”라고 했다.)

Attorney Choi, a native of Paju, Gyeonggi Province, graduated from Seoul Myeongji High School and Seoul National University's College of Law. He served as head of the special investigations division at the Gwangju District Prosecutors' Office, chief of the Andong branch of the Daegu District Prosecutors' Office, and prosecutor in the inspection department of the Seoul High Prosecutors' Office before retiring in 2017. In 2019, during the Moon Jae-in administration, the then-opposition Bareunmirae Party had also recommended him as a candidate for special inspector. (최 변호사는 경기 파주 출신으로 서울 명지고·서울대 법대를 졸업하고, 광주지검 특수부장·대구지검 안동지청장·서울고검 감찰부 검사 등을 지내다 2017년 퇴직했다. 2019년 문재인 정부 때 야당이던 바른미래당이 특별감찰관 후보로 추천하기도 했다.)

The special inspector conducts ongoing oversight of misconduct by the president's spouse, relatives within the fourth degree of kinship, and public officials at or above the level of senior presidential secretary. Candidates must have at least 15 years of experience as a judge, prosecutor, or attorney, and the term is three years. When the National Assembly recommends three candidates, the president designates one of them, who is then appointed after a parliamentary confirmation hearing. The People Power Party has already nominated former prosecutor Kang Ji-sik (60, Training Institute Class 27) as its candidate for the opposition's share last April. (특별감찰관은 대통령 배우자와 4촌 이내 친족, 대통령비서실 수석비서관급 이상 공직자의 비위 행위를 상시 감찰한다. 15년 이상 판사·검사 또는 변호사 경력을 갖춰야 하며 임기는 3년이다. 국회가 후보 3명을 추천하면 대통령이 이 가운데 1명을 지명하고, 국회 인사청문회를 거쳐 임명된다. 국민의힘은 지난 4월 야당 몫 후보로 검사 출신 강지식(60·연수원 27기) 변호사를 내정한 상태다.)

Presidential chief of staff for public relations and communication, Sung Ki-hong, said that day, "Once the National Assembly recommends a special inspector candidate through a plenary session vote, the presidential office will proceed with the appointment expeditiously in accordance with procedures." The Democratic Party plans to complete the parliamentary recommendation process by August and also hold a confirmation hearing. <<>> (청와대 성기홍 홍보소통수석은 이날 “국회가 본회의 의결을 거쳐 특별감찰관 후보를 추천하면 청와대는 절차에 따라 신속히 임명을 진행할 예정”이라고 했다. 민주당은 8월 안에 국회 추천 절차를 마무리하고 인사청문회까지 실시한다는 방침이다.)

item.title: After 4-Trial System and Law Distortion Crime, Dismissal of Indictment... 'Triple Pressure Tactics' on the Court (4심제·법왜곡죄 이어 공소 기각… 재판부엔 ‘3중 압박법’)
item.description:
After 4-Trial System and Law Distortion Crime, Dismissal of Indictment... 'Triple Pressure Tactics' on the Court (4심제·법왜곡죄 이어 공소 기각… 재판부엔 ‘3중 압박법’)

Regarding the 'expansion of grounds for dismissal of indictment' provision in the Criminal Procedure Act amendment passed by the Democratic Party of Korea at the National Assembly plenary session on the 31st, concerns have been raised in the legal community that "if combined with the constitutional complaint system (Constitutional Court Act) and the law distortion crime (Criminal Act) that the Democratic Party pushed through earlier this year, it could be used as a means to pressure the court or delay trials." The provision was suddenly inserted by the Democratic Party a few days ago, and the People Power Party views it as "work to erase the trials of President Lee Jae-myung." <<> Hard-line lawmakers of the Democratic Party recently added 'serious illegality' and 'clear deviation' by prosecutors to the grounds for dismissal of indictment under Article 327 of the Criminal Procedure Act. Dismissal of indictment decisions are possible not only in the first instance but also in appellate and final appeals. <<> Accordingly, there are indications that one could file a constitutional complaint in protest of the Supreme Court's ruling on whether to dismiss an indictment. The so-called '4-trial system' constitutional complaint, which allows constitutional petitions against final Supreme Court rulings, was passed by the National Assembly in February under the leadership of the Democratic Party. Until just before its passage, concerns were raised in the legal community that it "may be unconstitutional." Ji Sung-woo, a professor at Sungkyunkwan University Law School, said, "In ordinary cases, it is rare for a defendant to argue for dismissal of an indictment even at the final appeal. However, in political cases, there is a possibility of using it to drag out the trial for a long time and pressure the court, regardless of the final outcome." <<> There are also forecasts that if the court does not accept the argument for dismissal of an indictment, additional responses using the law distortion crime could follow. The law distortion crime was also widely considered to have constitutional issues, but it was introduced in February under the leadership of the Democratic Party. It punishes judges or prosecutors who intentionally distort the law despite knowing the requirements for applying statutes, thereby affecting the outcome of a trial. <<> Hwang Do-su, a former professor at Konkuk University Law School and former researcher at the Constitutional Court, said, "It is difficult to rule out the possibility that it could be used in a way where a defendant files a complaint against a prosecutor or judge under the law distortion crime and then argues, 'Since related proceedings are ongoing, the main trial must also wait.'" He added, "It is not easy for a court to judge whether a prosecutor acted illegally in an ordinary criminal case. However, if a special counsel investigation is passed following a parliamentary audit to determine whether President Lee Jae-myung was indicted by manipulation in the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance cases, the Criminal Procedure Act amendment could face criticism as 'tailor-made legislation' for the president." (더불어민주당이 31일 국회 본회의에서 처리한 형사소송법 개정안의 ‘공소기각 사유 확대’ 조항을 두고 법조계에서는 “민주당이 올해 초 강행 처리한 재판소원(헌법재판소법)·법왜곡죄(형법)와 맞물릴 경우 재판부를 압박하거나 재판을 지연시키는 수단으로 활용될 수 있다”는 우려가 제기됐다. 이 조항은 민주당이 수일 전 갑자기 끼워넣었는데, 국민의힘은 “이재명 대통령의 재판을 지우기 위한 작업”이라고 보고 있다.)

item.title: Ruling party: "Leverage introduced without party-government consultations"… Distancing from government as criticism grows (與 “레버리지, 당정 협의 없이 도입”… 원성 커지자 정부와 거리두기)
item.description:
Ruling party: "Leverage introduced without party-government consultations"… Distancing from government as criticism grows (與 “레버리지, 당정 협의 없이 도입”… 원성 커지자 정부와 거리두기)

The ruling Democratic Party of Korea stated on the 31st that "single-stock leverage ETFs were introduced without party-government consultations" and that "we will review whether the process of introducing leverage products and investor protection measures were appropriate and sufficient." This is seen as an attempt to distance itself from the government as investor complaints grow over extreme volatility in the domestic stock market and backlash against real estate policies intensifies, particularly in the capital region. There are signs of discontent within the ruling party that President Lee Jae-myung, who has been vocal on policy issues such as stocks and real estate, has said nothing during his current South America tour. (여당인 더불어민주당이 “단일 종목 레버리지 ETF는 당정 협의 없이 도입됐다”며 “레버리지 도입 과정과 투자자 보호 장치가 적정하고 충분했는지 점검하겠다”고 31일 밝혔다. 국내 증시의 극심한 변동성으로 투자자들의 원성이 커지고, 수도권을 중심으로 부동산 정책에 대한 반발이 거세지자 정부와 거리를 두려는 것으로 풀이된다. 그간 주식·부동산 등 정책 현안에 많은 목소리를 내왔던 이재명 대통령이 이번 남미 순방 기간에는 아무 얘기를 하지 않는 데 대한 여당 내 불만이 감지된다.)

At a party meeting that day, Han Byung-do, acting party leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party, said, "Recently, circuit breakers were triggered in both the KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets, significantly expanding volatility in the financial markets," adding, "The Democratic Party will calmly and transparently review whether the process of introducing single-stock leverage products and investor protection measures were sufficient." Park Hong-bae, a Democratic Party lawmaker on the National Assembly's Policy Affairs Committee, appeared on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel that day and said, "I apologize, but the launch of this product (single-stock leverage ETF) was prepared without the ruling party's knowledge, and the product was released without party-government consultations with the ruling party." (민주당 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 이날 당 회의에서 “최근 코스피와 코스닥 양 시장에서 서킷브레이커가 발동하는 등 금융시장의 변동성이 크게 확대됐다”며 “민주당은 단일 종목 레버리지 상품 도입 과정과 투자자 보호 장치가 충분했는지 차분하고 투명하게 점검하겠다”고 했다. 국회 정무위원회 소속 박홍배 민주당 의원은 이날 김어준씨 유튜브에 나와 “죄송한 말씀입니다만 여당도 모르는 사이에 이 상품(단일 종목 레버리지 ETF)의 출시가 준비됐고, 여당과의 당정 협의도 없이 상품이 나왔다”고 했다.)

The issue of "delisting single-stock leverage ETFs" is also affecting the Democratic Party's national convention. During a TV debate of party leader candidates on the 29th, candidate Jung Cheong-rae asked, "How about suspending trading of single-stock leverage ETFs even temporarily?" but candidate Kim Min-seok responded, "Is it right to go straight to a trading suspension? It would be better for the authorities to conduct a more careful review." In political circles, there is talk that candidate Jung is highlighting candidate Kim's responsibility, as Kim was Prime Minister at the time leverage ETFs were introduced in May. (‘단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 상장폐지’ 문제는 민주당 전당대회에도 영향을 주고 있다. 29일 당대표 후보 TV 토론에서 정청래 후보는 “당분간이라도 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF를 거래 중단하는 것이 어떻겠느냐”고 했지만, 김민석 후보는 “이걸 바로 거래 중단으로 가는 것이 맞느냐. 조금 더 당국에서 신중한 검토를 하는 것이 좋겠다”고 했다. 정치권에서는 정 후보가 레버리지 ETF가 도입된 5월 당시 국무총리였던 김 후보의 책임론을 부각시키고 있다는 말이 나왔다.)

Although the stock market posted a sharp rebound on the 31st, individual investors, weary of a market swinging between surges and crashes daily, recorded net selling of over 10 trillion won that day. A ruling party official said, "Trust in the domestic stock market has collapsed, and with distrust in real estate policies added on top, it is spreading into doubts about the 'competence' of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (31일 증시는 큰 폭의 반등을 기록했지만 매일 폭등과 폭락을 오가는 장세에 지친 개인들은 이날 10조원 이상을 순매도했다. 여권 관계자는 “국내 증시에 대한 신뢰가 무너졌고, 부동산 정책에 대한 불신까지 더해져 이재명 정부의 ‘실력’에 대한 의심으로 번지고 있다”고 전했다.)

Public sentiment on real estate has worsened further since the president's "national debate on real estate" on the 23rd. Even Han Mun-do, a professor of real estate at Seoul Digital University who leans pro-government, said, "If we continue on the current trajectory, it's not even as good as the second season of the Moon Jae-in administration." Party leader candidate Song Young-gil said, "If the supply cliff continues, it could spell big trouble in the 2028 general election. The policy line at the presidential office needs to be re-examined." (부동산 민심은 지난 23일 이 대통령의 ‘부동산 국민 대토론회’ 이후 더욱 악화하고 있다. 친여 성향인 한문도 서울디지털대 부동산학과 교수마저 “현재까지 패턴으로 가면 문재인 정부 시즌2만도 못하다”고 했다. 송영길 당대표 후보는 “공급 절벽이 계속되면 2028년 총선에서 큰일 날 수 있다. 청와대 정책 라인을 재점검해야 한다”고 했다.)

Amid all this, President Lee, currently on a tour of South America, has made no mention of domestic policy issues. This contrasts with his usual habit of frequently posting about current issues on X (formerly Twitter). The only recent response from the presidential office regarding the single-stock leverage ETF has been from Kim Yong-beom, chief of staff for policy at the presidential office, who said at a briefing with local reporters in Brazil on the 28th (local time), "The significant volatility over the past two to three months was not unique to our market" and "The leverage ETF is not the sole cause." (이런 가운데 남미를 순방 중인 이 대통령은 국내 정책 현안에 대한 언급을 하지 않고 있다. 평소 X(옛 트위터)에 자주 현안 관련 글을 올리던 것과 다른 모습이다. 최근 청와대의 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 등에 대한 반응은 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 28일(현지 시각) 브라질 현지 기자 브리핑에서 “지난 2~3개월 큰 변동성이 나타난 것은 우리 시장만 그런 것은 아니었다” “레버리지 ETF만이 원인은 아니다”라고 한 것이 거의 유일하다.)

Even within the presidential office, concerns have been raised that this was a "mishandled response." A presidential office official said, "Director Kim's remarks, while not intended as such, could come across as irresponsible to the public," adding, "It was a politically regrettable briefing." Accordingly, it is understood that discussions are underway for President Lee to directly address the relevant issues upon his return, such as through a briefing aboard Air Force One during the flight back, to quell the controversy. (이를 두고 청와대 내부에서도 ‘잘못된 대응’이라는 우려가 나왔다. 청와대 관계자는 “김 실장의 발언은 실제 의도가 그렇지는 않겠지만 국민에게 무책임하게 들릴 수 있다”며 “정무적으로 아쉬운 브리핑이었다”고 했다. 이에 따라 논란을 가라앉히기 위해 이 대통령이 귀국할 때 공군 1호기 기내 간담회 등을 통해 관련 현안을 직접 설명하는 방안이 논의되는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Acknowledges Early Disadvantage in Chungcheong and PK... "Will Close the Gap to 7 Percentage Points and Turn It Around in Honam" (김민석, 충청·PK 초반 열세 인정… “7%p 차로 막아 호남서 뒤집을 것”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Acknowledges Early Disadvantage in Chungcheong and PK... "Will Close the Gap to 7 Percentage Points and Turn It Around in Honam" (김민석, 충청·PK 초반 열세 인정… “7%p 차로 막아 호남서 뒤집을 것”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea announces the results of the Chungcheong region primary on the 1st and the Busan·Ulsan·Gyeongnam primary on the 2nd ahead of the August 17 national convention, party leader candidate Kim Min-seok acknowledged his early disadvantage on the 31st, saying, "(In Chungcheong and Busan·Ulsan·Gyeongnam) Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae will have the advantage." He added, "(In Chungcheong and Busan·Ulsan·Gyeongnam) If I can limit the deficit to at most 7 percentage points, I can turn things around (in Honam and elsewhere)," and "This convention will be a '7-percentage-point comeback story.'" <<> Some within the party observed that "sensing Candidate Jeong's early lead, Candidate Kim preemptively set up a defensive shield to cushion the shock of defeat." In contrast, Candidate Jeong's camp said, "We expect to lead by more than 10 percentage points in the first two regions and secure a majority victory," adding, "We plan to cement the momentum of dominance in the early stages." <<> In a YouTube channel interview that morning, Candidate Kim said, "The first week of the traveling primary includes Chungcheong, where I expect Candidate Jeong to have the advantage, and Busan, where Candidate Jeong's key associates reportedly have strong organizational (support base) control." Earlier, pro-Myung (pro-Lee Jae-myung) Candidate Kim and Candidate Song Young-gil's camps had protested that the schedule favored Candidate Jeong, noting that the first primary was in Chungcheong—Candidate Jeong's hometown—and the second in Busan·Ulsan·Gyeongnam, where Lee Sang-ho, a former Busan Saha-eul district committee chair and pro-Roh figure who has supported former Candidate Jeong, has been active. <<> Candidate Kim said, "If I trail by around 7 percentage points in the first week, I'll tie in the second week and win big in the third week, securing a stable victory." However, he added, "If the gap grows to 10 percentage points (in the first week), then it will become a nail-biting bloodbath." In the second week of the primary, results from Incheon·Jeju (8th) and Daegu·Gyeongbuk·Gangwon (9th) will be announced. This will be followed by Gwangju·South Jeolla·North Jeolla (15th), Gyeonggi·Seoul (16th), and the final results announcement (17th). <<> Candidate Kim's camp believes the preferential voting system introduced in this party leader election works in Candidate Kim's favor. His camp plans to achieve a landslide victory in Honam—where 30% of party members with voting rights reside and which is considered the biggest battleground of this convention—to block Candidate Jeong from securing a majority of votes. Then, once Candidate Song is eliminated due to insufficient first-preference votes, they intend to absorb Song's votes and win. <<> In contrast, Candidate Jeong's camp expects that winning in the Seoul and Gyeonggi regions—where his most fervent supporters are concentrated—following Chungcheong and Busan·Ulsan·Gyeongnam will create a "bandwagon effect." A source from Candidate Jeong's camp said, "As Candidate Kim shakes up the party with baseless claims of Shincheonji interference in the convention, Candidate Jeong is rapidly closing the gap even in Honam." In a Facebook post that day, Candidate Jeong said, "The face of victory has begun to peek into view." <<> Meanwhile, the Democratic Party's convention election management committee issued warnings and corrective orders to Candidate Jeong and pro-Chung (pro-Chung Sye-kyun) supreme council member candidates. On the 25th, Lee Jae-young, director of the Democratic Research Institute and head of the party's Gyeongnam Yangsan-gap district committee, held a "Gyeongnam Yangsan party member meeting" and invited Candidate Jeong along with supreme council member candidates Lee Seong-yoon, Choi Min-hee, and Han Min-su. The election committee determined that they violated party officer election rules by attending an unauthorized meeting. For Lee Jae-young, the Democratic Research Institute director who hosted the meeting, the committee requested severe disciplinary action, including suspension from duties, from the party's ethics tribunal on charges of violating neutrality obligations. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 1일 충청권, 2일 부산·울산·경남 경선 결과를 발표하는 가운데 김민석 당대표 후보가 31일 “(충청과 부울경에선) 정청래 후보가 유리할 것”이라며 초반 열세를 인정했다. 그러면서 “(충청·부울경에서) 최대 7%p 마이너스(패배)까지만 막아내면 (호남 등에서) 역전할 수 있다”며 “이번 전당대회는 ‘7%p 역전극’이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Mega special zones push to relax 52-hour workweek... Labor circles ask, "Why sacrifice labor rights?" (메가특구 ‘주52시간 완화’ 추진하자… 노동계 “왜 노동권 제물 삼나”)
item.description:
Mega special zones push to relax 52-hour workweek... Labor circles ask, "Why sacrifice labor rights?" (메가특구 ‘주52시간 완화’ 추진하자… 노동계 “왜 노동권 제물 삼나”)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the government are pushing measures to significantly ease labor regulations in "mega special zones," including the Honam semiconductor cluster, such as exempting them from the 52-hour maximum workweek and relaxing restrictions on fixed-term and dispatched workers. These are measures the Democratic Party had strongly opposed in the past. Labor circles reacted on the 31st, saying, "Is the government pursuing advanced industries by using labor rights as a sacrificial offering?" Some Democratic lawmakers also conveyed their opposition to the party leadership and the government, but opinions that it is "absolutely necessary for the development of the Honam region" are reportedly also significant. <<> The ruling party and the government are reviewing plans to include provisions in the "Mega Special Zone Special Act" that would greatly ease labor regulations. Notably, a measure being discussed is the introduction of a so-called "white-collar exemption," which would not apply the 52-hour weekly work limit to research and development (R&D) workers and would allow employers to skip paying overtime, night, and holiday premiums. Some in the government suggested expanding the existing "special extended work" system, which allows exceptions to the 52-hour workweek under special circumstances such as a surge in workload, but concerns were raised that the review and approval process is cumbersome, shifting the direction toward creating an outright exemption from the 52-hour rule from the start. (더불어민주당과 정부가 호남 반도체 클러스터 등 ‘메가특구’에 주 최대 52시간 근무제와 기간제·파견 근로자 고용 제한 등 노동 규제를 대폭 완화해 주는 방안을 추진하고 있다. 이는 과거 민주당이 강하게 반대했던 내용들이다. 노동계는 31일 “정부가 노동권을 제물삼아 첨단산업을 추진하는 것이냐”고 반발했다. 민주당 일부 의원들도 지도부와 정부 측에 반대 의견을 전달했지만, “호남 발전을 위해 반드시 필요하다”는 의견도 만만치 않은 것으로 알려졌다.)

The party and government are also reviewing a plan to extend the settlement period for the flexible working hours system from the current one to three months to six months. The flexible working hours system allows working more than 52 hours in a given period as long as the average working hours over the settlement period do not exceed 52 hours per week. If the settlement period is extended to six months, workers could, for example, work up to 80 hours a week for 16 consecutive weeks and then work reduced hours for the remaining 10 weeks to balance the average. (당정은 ‘메가특구 특별법’에 노동 규제를 대폭 완화하는 내용을 담는 방안을 검토하고 있다. 대표적으로 연구·개발(R&D) 직군 근로자에게 근로 시간 주 52시간 상한제를 적용하지 않고, 연장·야간·휴일 근로 수당을 주지 않아도 되게 하는, 이른바 ‘화이트칼라 이그젬션(exemption·면제)’을 도입하는 방안이 거론된다. 정부 일각에서는 업무량 폭증 등 특별한 사정이 있는 경우 주 52시간제 예외를 인정해주는 기존 ‘특별 연장 근로’ 제도를 확대하자는 의견도 있었지만, 심사·승인 절차가 까다롭다는 지적이 나와, 아예 처음부터 주 52시간제 적용 예외를 두자는 쪽으로 방향이 바뀌었다.)

The party and government are also reviewing plans to extend the maximum employment period for fixed-term workers from the current two years to four years, and to expand the types of work where dispatched workers can be used. Under the current Dispatched Workers Act, dispatched workers are only allowed in 32 job categories, including computers, patents, translation and interpretation, and cleaning. The business community has argued that the exclusion of work such as direct production processes in manufacturing hinders flexible workforce management. (당정은 선택적 근로시간제 정산을 현행 1~3개월 단위가 아니라 6개월 단위로 할 수 있게 하는 방안도 검토 중이다. 선택적 근로시간제는 정산 기간 평균 근로시간이 주 52시간을 넘지 않는다면 특정 기간에는 52시간을 넘길 수 있게 하는 제도로, 정산 기간이 6개월로 늘어나면 16주 연속으로 주 80시간 일하고 나머지 10주를 단축 근무해 평균을 맞추는 식으로 일할 수 있게 된다.)

These labor deregulation measures are ones that the Lee Myung-bak, Park Geun-hye, and Yoon Suk Yeol administrations previously pursued, and each time, the Democratic Party opposed them, saying they "would hollow out the Labor Standards Act and could infringe on workers' right to health." Last year, when the semiconductor special act was pursued through bipartisan agreement, a plan to exempt certain job categories in the semiconductor industry from the 52-hour workweek was discussed but was dropped at the last minute due to Democratic Party opposition. At the time, the Democratic Party argued that companies could operate working hours flexibly enough using existing systems such as special extended work. Now, just six months after the semiconductor special act was passed, the Democratic Party has changed its stance. (당정은 기간제 근로자를 고용할 수 있는 기간을 현행 최대 2년에서 4년으로 늘리는 방안, 파견 근로자를 투입할 수 있는 업무를 늘리는 방안도 검토하고 있다. 현행 파견법은 컴퓨터, 특허, 번역·통역, 청소 등 32개 업무에 한해 파견 근로자를 쓸 수 있게 하고 있다. 경영계는 여기에 제조업 직접 생산 공정 업무 등이 포함되지 않아, 유연한 인력 운용을 방해하고 있다고 주장해 왔다.)

Democratic lawmakers on the National Assembly's Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs, and Startups Committee, which will review the bill, are broadly in favor of the labor deregulation. One committee lawmaker said, "Semiconductor research staff can earn annual salaries exceeding 150 million won. Allowing such people, with their consent, to work intensively during certain weeks doesn't seem like it would be a problem." Many lawmakers representing districts in South Jeolla Province and Gwangju, where the Honam semiconductor cluster will be located, expressed support based on "regional development" logic. A first-term lawmaker said, "The mega special zones are fundamentally about providing regulatory exceptions for regional and industrial development, and there is no reason labor regulatory exceptions should be excluded. If it's necessary for regional development and balanced national growth, there's no reason to refuse." (이런 노동 규제 완화 방안들은 과거 이명박·박근혜·윤석열 정부가 추진했던 것으로, 그때마다 민주당은 “근로기준법을 껍데기로 만들고 노동자 건강권을 침해할 수 있다”며 반대해 왔다. 지난해에는 여야 합의로 반도체특별법을 추진하면서 반도체 산업의 일부 직군에 주 52시간제 예외를 두는 방안이 논의됐지만, 민주당 반대로 막판에 법안에서 빠졌다. 당시 민주당은 특별 연장 근로 등 현행 제도만 써도 기업이 근로시간을 충분히 유연하게 운영할 수 있다고 주장했었다. 이랬던 민주당이 반도체특별법 처리 6개월 만에 분위기가 바뀐 것이다.)

On the other hand, many Democratic lawmakers on the Environment and Labor Committee, which handles labor affairs, have reportedly conveyed concerns to the government. One committee lawmaker said, "If all these exceptions are included in the bill, it would be deregulation at a level that even conservative governments never attempted. This is not something that can be justified solely by the cause of balanced regional development." (법안을 심사하게 될 국회 산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원회 소속 민주당 의원들은 노동 규제 완화에 대체로 찬성한다는 입장이다. 산자위 한 의원은 “반도체 연구 인력은 연봉이 1억5000만원이 넘기도 하는데, 그런 사람들에 한해 본인 동의하에 특정 주간에 몰아서 일할 수 있게 하는 것이 문제가 될 것 같지는 않다”고 했다. 호남 반도체 클러스터가 들어서게 될 전남광주 지역구 의원 다수는 ‘지역 발전’ 논리로 찬성 입장을 보였다. 한 초선 의원은 “메가특구가 기본적으로 지역·산업 발전을 위해 규제 특례를 주는 것인데, 노동 규제 특례라고 해서는 안 될 이유는 없다”며 “지역 발전과 국가 균형 발전을 위해 필요하다면 마다할 이유가 없을 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party leadership and the government have for now taken the position that "nothing is confirmed and it is still under review." Kang Jun-hyun, the Democratic Party's senior spokesperson, said, "The details are being discussed at the standing committee level, and no conclusion has been reached yet. There are differences of opinion within the party, and the matter should be decided through sufficient deliberation." The Ministry of Employment and Labor said, "The labor deregulation measures came up during discussions explaining various on-site demands and positions from all sides, and no specific details of the mega special zone special act have been confirmed." (반면 노동 분야를 다루는 기후환경에너지노동위원회 소속 민주당 의원 다수는 정부에 우려 의견을 전달한 것으로 알려졌다. 기후노동위 한 의원은 “저 특례들을 법안에 모두 담으면, 보수 정부도 시도하지 못했던 수준의 규제 완화가 된다”며 “지역 균형 발전이라는 명분만으로 할 수 있는 문제가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Labor circles reacted strongly. The Korean Confederation of Trade Unions said in a statement, "We will never tolerate any attempt to turn the mega special zones into a testing ground for labor deregulation. The easing of labor regulations is a regression." The Federation of Korean Trade Unions also said, "This is an attempt to roll back workers' basic labor rights, right to health, and employment stability under the pretext of fostering advanced industries. It not only encourages long working hours but also deprives workers of statutory allowances they are rightfully entitled to—a deterioration of labor standards." (민주당 지도부와 정부는 일단 “확정된 게 아니라 검토 중”이라는 입장이다. 강준현 민주당 수석대변인은 “세부 내용은 상임위 차원에서 논의되고 있는 것으로, 아직 결론이 난 것은 없다”며 “당내에 이견이 있고, 충분한 숙의를 통해 결정해야 할 것”이라고 했다. 노동부는 “(노동 규제 완화 방안은) 현장의 다양한 요구 사항과 각계의 입장을 포함해 논의 상황을 설명하는 과정에서 나온 것으로, 메가특구 특별법의 구체적인 내용은 확정된 바 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: With Public Sentiment on Prosecutorial Power and Real Estate Shaky, Lee Pulls Out a Card for Damage Control (수사권·부동산 흔들리는 민심에… 李, 수습용 카드 꺼내)
item.description:
With Public Sentiment on Prosecutorial Power and Real Estate Shaky, Lee Pulls Out a Card for Damage Control (수사권·부동산 흔들리는 민심에… 李, 수습용 카드 꺼내)

The Democratic Party of Korea, which had delayed recommending a candidate for over a year since President Lee Jae-myung expressed his intention to appoint a special inspector general, abruptly announced lawyer Choi Gil-soo as its candidate on the 31st. With President Lee on an overseas trip and the party leader position vacant, Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader, suddenly held a press briefing. In political circles, there is speculation that since this is a matter the party leadership would find difficult to decide on its own, the president's and the presidential office's intentions were effectively reflected in the decision. (이재명 대통령이 특별감찰관 임명 의지를 밝힌 지 1년이 넘도록 후보 추천을 미뤄온 더불어민주당이 31일 예고 없이 최길수 변호사를 후보로 발표했다. 이 대통령이 해외 순방 중이고 민주당 대표도 공석인 상황에서 한병도 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 갑자기 기자간담회를 연 것이다. 정치권에서는 여당 지도부가 독자적으로 결정하기 어려운 사안인 만큼 사실상 이 대통령과 청와대의 의중이 반영된 것 아니냐는 해석이 나왔다.)

The Democratic Party leadership held its briefing at 2 p.m. At that time, inside the National Assembly plenary chamber, the People Power Party was conducting a filibuster against a Criminal Procedure Act amendment bill aimed at abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers. With about two hours remaining before the filibuster's closure and the vote on the amendment, the ruling party announced the candidate for the body that would monitor the president's family and close aides, without any prior notice. (민주당 지도부가 간담회를 연 시각은 오후 2시였다. 당시 국회 본회의장에서는 국민의힘이 검사의 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 한 형사소송법 개정안에 반대해 필리버스터를 벌이고 있었다. 필리버스터 종결과 개정안 표결을 약 2시간 앞두고 여당이 별도 예고 없이 대통령 가족과 측근을 감시할 기구의 후보자를 발표한 것이다.)

On the 13th, People Power Party floor leader Jung Jeom-sik had urged the Democratic Party to recommend a candidate, noting that "no special inspector general has been appointed in the 405 days since President Lee's term began," but no visible progress had been made since. Eighteen days later, with President Lee abroad on a South America tour and floor leader Han also serving as acting party leader, the surprise announcement was made. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표가 지난 13일 “이 대통령 임기가 시작된 지 405일 동안 특별감찰관이 임명되지 않았다”며 민주당에 후보 추천을 요구했지만, 이후 공개적으로 드러난 진전은 없었다. 그러다 18일 뒤 이 대통령이 남미 순방으로 국내를 비우고, 한 원내대표가 당대표 직무대행까지 맡은 시점에 전격 발표가 이뤄졌다.)

A ruling party source said, "Floor leader Han previously served as senior presidential secretary for political affairs in the Moon Jae-in administration and is in close communication with the current presidential office. Although the president is on an overseas trip, this decision was likely made in coordination with the presidential office before being announced." At his press conference that day, floor leader Han also said, "The Democratic Party has responded responsibly to the president's decision to prove the transparency of power through institutions, not just words." (여권 관계자는 “한 원내대표는 문재인 정부 청와대 정무수석 출신이고 현 청와대와도 긴밀하게 소통하고 있다”며 “대통령이 해외 순방 중이지만 이번 결정도 청와대와 교감해 발표했을 것”이라고 했다. 한 원내대표도 이날 기자회견에서 “권력의 투명성을 말이 아닌 제도로 증명하겠다는 대통령의 결단에 민주당이 책임 있게 화답한 것”이라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party said there was no political intent behind the timing of the announcement. After President Lee's request in April, the ruling and opposition leadership had discussed a plan for each party and the Korean Bar Association to recommend one candidate each, but the process was delayed due to the local elections and the formation of the second half of the National Assembly. Floor leader Han said, "This has nothing to do with today's bill passage," adding, "There isn't much time left if we want to complete the confirmation process by August." Chief policy coordinator Cheon Jun-ho also explained that if it were delayed past the vacation season, it would be difficult to finish the process before the regular session. (민주당은 발표 시점에 정치적 의도는 없었다고 했다. 지난 4월 이 대통령의 요청 이후 여야 지도부가 양당과 대한변호사협회에서 각각 1명씩 추천하는 방안을 논의했지만, 지방선거와 후반기 원 구성 때문에 절차가 늦어졌다는 것이다. 한 원내대표는 “오늘 법안 통과와는 아무 관련이 없다”며 “8월 안에 청문 절차를 마치려면 시간이 많지 않다”고 했다. 천준호 원내운영수석도 휴가철 뒤로 넘기면 정기국회 전에 절차를 끝내기 어렵다고 설명했다.)

However, political circles have analyzed that the move is not unrelated to recent public opinion trends. In a national indicator survey released on the 30th, President Lee's positive approval rating for state affairs stood at 53%, the lowest since his inauguration, while 56% of respondents said he was mishandling real estate policy. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) (그러나 정치권에서는 최근의 여론 흐름과 무관하지 않다는 분석이 나왔다. 30일 발표된 전국지표조사에서 이 대통령의 국정 운영 긍정 평가는 53%로 취임 이후 가장 낮은 수준이었고, 부동산 정책을 잘못하고 있다는 응답은 56%였다. (자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조))

With controversies continuing over housing measures and single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs), the ruling party is seen as having pulled out the president's "self-restraint" pledge to soothe public sentiment. (부동산 대책과 단일 종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF)를 둘러싼 논란이 이어지는 상황에서 여당이 대통령의 ‘자기 견제’ 공약을 꺼내 민심 수습에 나섰다는 것이다.)

The situation within the party ahead of the Democratic Party's August 17 national convention is also intertwined. All leadership contenders are uniformly championing the "success of the Lee Jae-myung administration," while voices of checks within the ruling camp, including Yoo Si-min's so-called "reconstruction theory," have emerged over the relationship between the president and his core supporters, as well as the president's involvement in party affairs. The special inspector general recommendation can be interpreted as showing pro-Lee party members that campaign promises are being fulfilled while signaling acceptance of institutional checks in response to criticism over the concentration of power. (8·17 민주당 전당대회를 앞둔 당내 상황도 맞물려 있다. 당권 주자들이 일제히 ‘이재명 정부의 성공’을 내걸고 있고, 유시민 씨의 이른바 ‘재건축론’ 등 여권 내부에서는 대통령과 핵심 지지층의 관계, 대통령의 당 운영 관여를 둘러싼 견제 목소리도 나왔다. 특별감찰관 추천은 친명 성향 당원들에게 대선 공약 이행을 보여주는 동시에 권력 집중 비판에는 제도적 견제를 수용하겠다는 뜻으로 해석될 수 있다.)

It is also noteworthy that attorney Choi was a figure previously recommended as a special inspector general candidate by the Bareunmirae Party, the opposition at the time of the Moon Jae-in administration. A former prosecutor, he is known to have no particular ties to the Democratic Party or President Lee. The Democratic Party's choice to select a figure already vetted by a past opposition party, rather than someone from its own camp, is seen as an effort to reduce controversy over political neutrality and demonstrate the presidential office's willingness to accept inspections. (최 변호사가 문재인 정부 때 야당이던 바른미래당이 이미 특별감찰관 후보로 추천했던 인물이라는 점도 주목된다. 검찰 출신인 그는 민주당이나 이 대통령과 특별한 인연이 없는 것으로 알려졌다. 민주당이 자기 진영 인사보다 과거 야당이 검증한 인물을 다시 선택한 것은 정치적 중립성 논란을 줄이고 청와대의 감찰 수용 의지를 보여주려는 조치로 풀이된다.)

The Moon Jae-in administration criticized the situation surrounding the special inspector general under the Park Geun-hye administration but failed to appoint a successor, and the position also remained vacant throughout the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. There are also remarks that the Lee Jae-myung administration launching the actual candidate recommendation process just over a year into its term is noteworthy in that it has accepted a monitoring mechanism that may be inconvenient for the president himself. (문재인 정부는 박근혜 정부 당시 특별감찰관을 둘러싼 사태를 비판했지만 후임자를 임명하지 못했고, 윤석열 정부에서도 공석이 이어졌다. 이재명 정부가 출범 1년여 만에 실제 후보 추천 절차를 가동한 것은 대통령 스스로에게 불편할 수 있는 감시 장치를 받아들였다는 점에서 평가할 대목이라는 말도 나온다.)

In response to the Democratic Party's announcement that day, floor leader Jung said, "I suspect this may be an attempt to quell public anger over the abolition of supplementary investigative powers and divert attention," but added, "I welcome that they have finally moved to make a recommendation." He then called for the ruling and opposition parties and the Korean Bar Association to quickly consult on the remaining candidate, saying, "We will work to ensure the special inspector general is appointed promptly." <<>> (정 원내대표는 이날 민주당 발표에 대해 “보완수사권 폐지에 대한 국민의 분노를 잠재우고 관심을 돌리려는 것 아니냐는 의구심이 든다”면서도 “이제라도 추천에 나선 것은 환영한다”고 했다. 이어 여야와 대한변협이 나머지 후보 1명을 조속히 협의해야 한다며 “특별감찰관이 신속히 임명될 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: U.S. Drone Misidentification Incident: First Corps Staff Omitted Reports (美무인기 오인 사건, 1군단 실무진이 보고 누락했다)
item.description:
U.S. Drone Misidentification Incident: First Corps Staff Omitted Reports (美무인기 오인 사건, 1군단 실무진이 보고 누락했다)

It has been learned that behind our military's near-mistake of shooting down a U.S. Marine Corps reconnaissance drone, launched for a ROK-U.S. combined exercise on the 30th, as an "unidentified aerial vehicle" was a failure to report by the staff of the Army's First Corps, which has jurisdiction over the area. The U.S. military notified the First Corps of its drone flight plan, but the staff reportedly did not forward it to higher headquarters such as the Army Ground Operations Command (GOC), so procedures such as approval and dissemination were not carried out. (우리 군이 지난 30일 미 해병대가 한미 연합 훈련을 위해 띄운 정찰 무인기를 ‘미확인 비행체’로 오인하고 격추할 뻔한 배경에는 해당 지역을 관할하는 육군 1군단 실무진의 ‘보고 누락’이 있었던 것으로 알려졌다. 미군이 1군단에 무인기 비행 계획을 통보했지만 실무진이 상급 부대인 육군 지상작전사령부(지작사) 등에 전달하지 않아 승인·전파 같은 절차가 이뤄지지 않은 것으로 추정된다.)

The First Corps, positioned at the front lines of the western front facing North Korea, is supposed to play a key role in the defense of Seoul, but it has recently sparked controversy over "lax alert posture." This is because, in the first half of this year, the corps commander used his discretion to change guard duty guidelines, and it was revealed that core crew-served weapons such as the K6 heavy machine gun and the K4 high-speed grenade launcher were not loaded with live ammunition [The Dong-A Ilbo, July 29, 2026, A1, etc.]. In addition, the failure to report the U.S. drone training plan to higher command, which nearly led to a mistaken interception, has drawn criticism that "errors by a front-line corps, where military discipline and order should be strict, could have a negative impact on the overall morale of the military." (북한과 마주한 서부 전선 최전방에 위치한 1군단은 서울 방어에 핵심적 역할을 해야 하지만, 최근 ‘경계 태세 소홀’ 논란을 불렀다. 올 상반기 군단장 재량으로 경계 근무 지침을 바꿔, 핵심 공용화기인 K6 중(重)기관총과 K4 고속유탄발사기에 실탄을 삽탄(揷彈)하지 않고 있었던 사실<본지 2026년 7월 29일 자 A1면 등>이 드러났기 때문이다. 그에 더해 미국의 무인기 훈련 계획을 상부에 보고하지 않아 오인 요격할 뻔하는 일까지 이어지자, “군기와 규율이 엄해야 할 최전방 군단의 과오(過誤)가 군 전체 사기에 부정적인 영향을 미칠 수 있다”는 지적이 나온다.)

On the 31st, the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) announced that its Combat Readiness Inspection Office visited the First Corps that day to verify the communication processes and procedures between South Korea and the U.S. regarding the U.S. military drone situation. Typically, for the U.S. military to launch drones in the border area, it must notify the relevant ROK military unit of its flight plan in advance. The responsible unit then forwards it to the GOC or the Air Force Operations Command (AFOC), depending on altitude, to obtain flight approval. On the 30th, as part of KMEP, a ROK-U.S. Marine Corps combined exercise, the U.S. military launched a reconnaissance drone from the "Story Range" in Paju, Gyeonggi Province, which is managed by the U.S. military, and the unit with jurisdiction over that area was the First Corps. (31일 합동참모본부는 미군 무인기 상황과 관련한 한미 간 소통 과정과 절차 등을 확인하기 위해 이날 합참 전비태세검열실이 1군단을 찾았다고 밝혔다. 통상 미군이 접경 지역에서 무인기를 띄우려면, 한국군 관할 부대에 미리 비행 계획을 통보해야 한다. 그러면 해당 관할 부대가 고도에 따라 지작사나 공군작전사령부(공작사)에 전달해 비행 승인을 받는 구조다. 미군은 30일 한미 해병대의 연합훈련인 KMEP의 일환으로 미군이 관리하는 경기 파주시의 ‘스토리 사격장’에서 정찰 무인기를 출격시켰고, 이곳 관할 부대가 1군단이었다.)

The U.S. military reportedly notified the First Corps of its flight plan in advance and also sent an official document regarding the drone. However, it is known that for some reason, the First Corps staff did not inform higher headquarters. The drone's altitude was around 700 feet, which meant it fell under the category requiring notification to the GOC. Because of the First Corps' failure to report, the GOC's approval process also could not proceed. (미군은 사전에 1군단에 비행 계획을 통보했고 무인기 관련 공문도 보냈다고 한다. 그런데 1군단 실무진이 어떤 이유에서인지 상급 부대에 알리지 않았던 것으로 알려졌다. 이번 무인기의 고도는 700ft 안팎으로, 지작사 통보 대상이었다. 1군단의 보고 누락으로 지작사의 승인 절차도 진행되지 못했다.)

There are also arguments that an investigation is needed into why the U.S. military launched the drone without final approval from our military. However, there are also points that the U.S. military cannot be blamed, given that the drone was launched as part of KMEP training, which the ROK-U.S. Marine Corps conduct regularly 20 to 30 times a year, and the U.S. military notified all relevant units, including our Marine Corps and Army, in advance—if approval was not granted due to our side's reporting issue. Lim Cheol-gyun, a senior research fellow at the Korea Strategic Issues Institute, said, "Fundamentally, if only the reporting within the First Corps had been solid, the extremely dangerous situation of an 'allied forces drone shootdown,' which nearly occurred, would never have happened in the first place." (미군이 우리 군의 최종 승인 없이 무인기를 띄운 경위에 대해 조사가 필요하다는 주장도 나온다. 그러나 한미 해병대가 매년 20~30여 회 수시로 하는 KMEP 훈련의 일환으로 무인기가 출격했고, 미군은 우리 해병대와 육군 등 관련 부대에 모두 사전 통보를 했는데 우리 측의 보고 문제로 승인이 이뤄지지 않았다면 미군을 탓할 수 없다는 지적도 있다. 임철균 한국전략문제연구소 전문연구위원은 “기본적으로 1군단 내 보고만 확실했다면, ‘동맹군 무인기 격추’라는 초유의 사태가 발생할 뻔한 위험천만한 사건이 처음부터 일어나지 않았을 것”이라고 했다.)

It was also the First Corps that first detected the U.S. drone on the afternoon of the 30th using thermal observation devices (TOD) and local air defense radars. If the First Corps staff, who had been notified of the U.S. drone training plan, had disseminated that information even internally, it is expected that they could have confirmed whether it was a U.S. drone early in the situation. However, the First Corps reported the drone as an "unidentified aerial vehicle," issued the "Duru-mi" alert posture, which initiates air defense operations, prepared for interception, and tracked its flight path for about 1 hour and 30 minutes. Regarding why this situation occurred, the JCS said, "We plan to verify the overall issue and cannot confirm at this time." (30일 오후 처음 열상감시장비(TOD)와 국지방공레이더로 미군 무인기를 탐지한 것도 1군단이었다. 미군의 무인기 훈련 계획을 통보받았던 1군단 실무진이 그 사실을 부대 내에서라도 전파했다면, 상황 초기에 미군 무인기 여부를 확인할 수 있었을 것으로 예상된다. 하지만 1군단은 해당 무인기를 ‘미확인 비행체’로 보고 대공 작전에 돌입하는 ‘두루미’ 경계 태세를 발령한 후, 요격을 준비하고 1시간 30분가량 항적을 추적했다. 왜 이런 상황이 발생했는지에 대해 합참은 “전반적 사안을 확인할 예정으로 현재 확인이 어렵다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the JCS stated on the same day, "As of yesterday, the Army's GOC issued a fragmentary order to maintain a loaded state for crew-served weapons at front-line Guard Posts (GPs) and General Outposts (GOPs), keeping ammunition loaded on the weapons." This was not a change in guidelines at the corps level like the First Corps, but some GPs and GOPs under the Third Corps also had cases where crew-served weapons were not loaded with live ammunition, so the order now requires all front-line corps to keep live ammunition loaded during guard duty. (한편 합참은 이날 “육군 지작사는 어제부로 전방 부대 감시초소(GP)·일반전초(GOP) 공용화기 거치탄을 화기에 거치하는 삽탄 상태를 유지하도록 하는 단편 명령을 하달했다”고 밝혔다. 1군단처럼 군단 차원의 지침 변경은 아니지만 3군단 일부 GP·GOP에서도 공용화기에 실탄을 장전해 두지 않는 경우가 있었는데, 모든 전방 군단이 경계 근무 시 실탄을 장전해 두도록 명령한 것이다.)
